lines.ceb: Dali-dali lang, palihug. Naa pa koy klase.
lines.en: Hurry up, please. I still have a class.

lines.ceb: Pila pa ka oras ani? Kapoy na kaayo ko naghulat.
lines.en: How many more hours? I'm so tired of waiting.

lines.ceb: Kadugay ba! Ania na akong papeles, dali.
lines.en: This is taking forever! Here are my papers, quick.

lines.ceb: Okay ra tanan, promise. Stamp-i lang.
lines.en: Everything's fine, promise. Just stamp it.

lines.ceb: Kompleto na na tanan. Ayaw na lang tan-awa pag-ayo.
lines.en: It's all complete. No need to look too closely.

lines.ceb: Sakto man na tanan, gi-check na nako kagahapon.
lines.en: It's all correct, I checked it yesterday.

ask.ceb: Ha? Wala man nay problema. Sakto ra na.
ask.en: Huh? There's no problem there. That's right.

ask.ceb: Typo ra na sa ISMIS, dili sa akong papel.
ask.en: That's just an ISMIS typo, not my paper.

ask.ceb: Ingon ana gyud na sukad. Wala pay nag-reklamo.
ask.en: It's always been like that. Nobody's complained before.

lines.ceb: Gikuyogan ko ni Mama, para dali ra daw.
lines.en: My mom came with me, she says it'll be faster.

lines.ceb: Si Papa ang mosulti. Ania ang papeles.
lines.en: My dad will do the talking. Here are the papers.

argue.ceb: Ngano man adto pa? Gikan na mi didto ganina!
argue.en: Why go there? We were just there earlier!

argue.ceb: Dili ba nimo ma-buhat diri? Layo kaayo to.
argue.en: Can't you do it here, dear? That's so far.

argue.ceb: Sige na lang, pero kung ibalik mi diri, ikaw ang tubag.
argue.en: Fine, but if they send us back, that's on you.

lines.ceb: Diri ba ko magpa-picture para sa ID?
lines.en: Is this where I get my ID picture taken?

lines.ceb: Asa man ang library? Ay, diri diay ang Registrar?
lines.en: Where's the library? Oh, this is the Registrar?

lines.ceb: Diri ba ko mobayad sa uniform?
lines.en: Do I pay for my uniform here?

lines.ceb: Ingon ang akong ate diri daw ko mag-shift og course?
lines.en: My sister said I shift courses here?
